title: Oven-Roasted Thai Scallions Pad See Ew
description: A dairy-free-friendly twist on the classic Pad See Ew recipe, featuring oven-roasted Thai scallions for a jammy and shattering texture.
instructions: Cut the Thai scallions into 1-inch pieces and toss with olive oil, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Spread the scallion mixture on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until caramelized and jammy.
While the scallions are roasting, heat the fermented soybean paste and brown sugar in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Add the sliced garlic to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Add the cooked rice to the saucepan and stir to combine with the soybean paste mixture.
Once the scallions are done roasting, add them to the rice mixture and stir to combine.
Transfer the rice and scallion mixture to the donabe and top with chopped cilantro.
Serve the dish hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
